notes: This contract records a bounded official C++ API check that update-region specifications for an instance attribute use only dimensions available to that attribute. The Lab candidate is truncated and labels the rule §9.1.3.3; RL-360 records the complete source-backed mapping to §9.1.3.2 Instance attribute relationships and the omitted resulting-region-realization sentence. The case checks invalid-context rejection for registration and association using an unrelated dimension and a valid available-dimension registration. It does not claim complete DDM or conformance coverage.
